headline: Ukrainian Drone Attacks Target Russian Oil Refineries, Cutting Processing Capacity
summary: Ukrainian strikes again hit Russia's Afipsky and Ilsky oil refineries in Krasnodar Territory. The ongoing campaign has cut overall Russian crude oil processing by 30% and triggered regional fuel shortages.
why: Russia is one of the world's largest exporters of refined petroleum products and crude oil.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Disruptions to refined product output constrain global energy supply networks.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Physical damage to refining infrastructure cuts regional fuel availability and tightens global supply.
